scope: Exact-project-addressed official DevTools screenshots and public UI actions on a fixed clean local candidate; LOCAL memory/weather fixture BFF, not phone, OS background, calibration or final acceptance

viewport.limitation: Scaled simulator window pixels; native Canvas covers some ordinary WXML controls here

pixelComparisons.limitation: Small nonzero differences are retained as observed; no blanket pixel-identical claim

captureStateCorrection: First Moon record's located:null was the task helper incorrectly matching only the unqualified marker class. Actual marker has sky-located-object--disc; later direct attribute, screenshot and source-return verify the Moon marker. No production repair was needed.
sourceVerificationCorrection: Moon source-route params do not select the data version. API query selects coverage-v2; the actual source title/id, manifest and source UI establish the variant. English source limitations include measured-area coverage and neutral missing-area display. The first task expectation of a Chinese word/route param was invalid.
